name: Patient
definition: A person enrolled in the thrombosis study. Each patient has a unique patient identifier and one consolidated patient-level record.
scope: Patient-level attributes: identifier, sex, birthday, diagnosis, inpatient/outpatient status and patient record dates. Visits and laboratory panels are separate child records.

name: Patient Identifier
definition: Unique identifier assigned to a patient; the join key linking patient, examination and laboratory records.
scope: Stored once per patient in tab02.fld001. tab01.fld001 and tab03.fld001 use the same declared reference, but only part of tab01 resolves to a patient record.

name: Sex
definition: Recorded sex of the patient, coded 'M' for male and 'F' for female.
scope: Patient-level attribute. Blank values exist and are unknown, not a third category.

name: Birthday
definition: Patient date of birth, stored as a calendar date.
scope: Used to derive age and to filter by birth year. One patient has no birthday recorded.

name: Age
definition: Patient age in whole years, computed as the difference between the current calendar year and the year of birth. No age column is stored.
scope: Derived and time-dependent: the same patient yields different ages in different calendar years. Applies only where a birthday is recorded.

name: Patient Diagnosis
definition: The disease or diseases recorded for a patient at patient level; free-text labels that may combine several diagnoses separated by commas and may be marked 'susp' for suspected.
scope: One consolidated label per patient (tab02.fld008). Use for patient-level questions such as 'diagnosed with SLE' or 'most common disease'.

name: Examination Diagnosis
definition: Diagnosis recorded on an individual examination record, which may be more specific to that visit than the patient-level diagnosis.
scope: Recorded per examination in tab01.fld008 (475 of 806 non-null, 181 distinct labels). Linkable to patient or laboratory records only for the subset of examination IDs that resolve in tab02.

name: Examination
definition: A clinical examination record for a patient on a given date, holding ANA results, anti-cardiolipin values, thrombosis level, coagulation and symptom flags, and a visit-level diagnosis.
scope: One row per examination in tab01. Records carry fld001 as patient identifier, but only 69 of 763 distinct identifiers also exist in the patient table.

name: Examination Date
definition: Calendar date on which an examination record was created.
scope: tab01.fld002; range 1989-04-18 to 1998-04-17; 10 blank values.

name: Inpatient or Outpatient Status
definition: Whether the patient was an inpatient or an outpatient, coded '+' for inpatient and '-' for outpatient.
scope: Patient-level attribute in tab02.fld018. Blank and '+(' values exist and should be treated as unknown or inpatient respectively, not as additional categories.

name: Laboratory Test Panel
definition: A laboratory test panel for one patient collected on one date; the same patient usually has many panels over time.
scope: One row per patient and test date in tab03. 13,908 rows for 302 patients, with 1 to 226 panels per patient.

name: Laboratory Test Date
definition: Date on which a laboratory panel was collected.
scope: tab03.fld019; range 1981-01-27 to 1999-03-04; stored as ISO date text and unique per patient.

name: Albumin
definition: Serum albumin concentration measured in the laboratory panel, expressed in g/dL.
scope: Laboratory measurement available for part of the panels; values below a stated cutoff mean low albumin.

name: ALT / GPT
definition: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT, also called GPT) activity in serum, expressed in U/L.
scope: Laboratory measurement; values above the stated upper limit mean elevated liver enzyme.

name: Blood Glucose
definition: Blood glucose (GLU) concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Laboratory measurement; normal versus abnormal is decided by the stated glucose cutoff.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol (T-CHO) concentration in blood.
scope: Laboratory measurement; normal versus high is decided by the stated cholesterol cutoff.

name: Creatinine
definition: Serum creatinine concentration, a marker of renal function.
scope: Laboratory measurement; abnormal versus normal is decided by the stated creatinine cutoff.

name: Creatine Phosphokinase
definition: Creatine phosphokinase (CPK, also CK) enzyme activity in serum.
scope: Laboratory measurement; normal versus beyond-normal is decided by the stated CPK cutoff.

name: Urea Nitrogen
definition: Blood urea nitrogen (UN) concentration.
scope: Laboratory measurement with a stated borderline value in the workload.

name: Platelet Count
definition: Platelet count (PLT) from the complete blood count in the laboratory panel.
scope: Laboratory measurement; a stated threshold marks elevated platelet values.

name: Immunoglobulin G
definition: Serum immunoglobulin G (IgG) concentration.
scope: Laboratory measurement; normal range is stated by a lower and an upper bound.

name: Immunoglobulin M
definition: Serum immunoglobulin M (IgM) concentration.
scope: Laboratory measurement; abnormal is defined by a lower and an upper bound.

name: C-Reactive Protein
definition: C-reactive protein (CRP) result, an inflammation marker. Qualitative results ('+', '-') and numeric or threshold values coexist in one column.
scope: Laboratory measurement; abnormal is expressed as a positive qualitative result.

name: Anti-Scl70 Antibody
definition: Anti-Scl-70 (anti-topoisomerase I) autoantibody result recorded either as a negative indicator ('negative' or '0') or as a numeric titer.
scope: Laboratory measurement present on a small subset of panels; negative results dominate.

name: Anti-SSB Antibody
definition: Anti-SSB (anti-La) autoantibody result recorded either as a negative indicator ('negative' or '0') or as a numeric titer.
scope: Laboratory measurement present on a small subset of panels.

name: Anti-Centromere Antibody
definition: Anti-centromere autoantibody result recorded either as a negative indicator ('negative' or '0') or as a numeric titer.
scope: Laboratory measurement present on a very small subset of panels.

name: ANA Pattern
definition: Antinuclear antibody (ANA) staining pattern, recorded as one or more letter codes (S, P, D, N) that may be combined in a comma-separated string.
scope: Examination-level result in tab01.fld006. 'Only S' means exactly the single code 'S' rather than a combined pattern such as 'P,S'.

name: ANA Titer
definition: Antinuclear antibody titer, recorded as a numeric dilution level where 0 indicates not detected.
scope: Examination-level result in tab01.fld005; observed values 0, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024 and 4096.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody level measured in the examination, recorded separately for two immunoglobulin isotypes.
scope: Two numeric columns in tab01: fld003 for the IgG isotype and fld004 for the IgM isotype. Statements may name only the isotype, so the target column must be chosen by isotype.

name: Thrombosis Level
definition: Ordinal degree of thrombosis recorded on the examination, from 0 (none) to 3 (highest recorded degree).
scope: Examination-level categorical attribute in tab01.fld013.

name: Degree of Coagulation
definition: Coagulation-related abnormality flags recorded on the examination as '+' (positive/present) or '-' (negative/absent) in three adjacent columns.
scope: tab01.fld009, fld010 and fld011. A 'positive degree of coagulation' means at least one of the three flags is '+'.
aliases: positive measure of degree of coagulation

name: Symptom Manifestation
definition: Free-text description of the clinical symptoms recorded on an examination, such as AMI, CNS lupus, DVT, abortion or thrombocytopenia.
scope: tab01.fld012. A non-null value means symptoms were recorded; a null value means no symptom was recorded.

name: Patient Record Date
definition: A patient-level calendar date held in tab02.fld016 and present for 1022 of 1238 patients. The workload treats a missing value as 'data not recorded'; whether the column represents death, discharge or last contact cannot be established from the data alone.
scope: Do not use for visit or laboratory timing; those come from tab01.fld002 and tab03.fld019.
